raw_audit.timestamp_note: The file does not say whether a timestamp marks the START or the END of its 10-minute interval, or which time zone it uses. The pipeline is safe either way because every feature for target hour H uses only hours that finished before H (see features.py and tests/test_leakage.py).

hourly_conversion.rule: hourly energy = sum of 6 ten-minute Wh readings / 1000; temperature and humidity = mean; an hour with fewer than 6 readings is set to NaN and never imputed

clock_shift_evidence.reading: If the across_dst pair is best at shift 1 while both controls are best at 0, daily routines move one hour earlier on the file clock after the DST date: the file clock is fixed winter time.

decisions: Hourly energy = sum of six 10-minute Wh readings / 1000 (kWh); no imputation of incomplete hours.
Temperature/humidity = hourly mean. Peaks and high values are kept.
rv1/rv2 and airport weather are excluded from the primary feature set.
Calendar features use local wall-clock time (file clock + 1 h from 2016-03-27 02:00) because routines shift 1 h at the DST date.
Features use only hours finished before the target hour (shift >= 1 on a regular hourly index).
First 168 hours are lost because lag-168 needs a full week of history.
